papers.title_en: Read the Route: Attention-Steered Hypergraph Retrieval for Multi-hop RAG
papers.authors: Jiate Liu, Liuyi Chen, Xiaofei Yuan, Yifu Tang, Zihan Yang, Xu Zhou, Zhengyi Yang
papers.evidence: 面向多跳RAG的注意力引导超图检索
papers.tldr: 多跳问答中的GraphRAG检索存在两类局限：扩散或相似度方法沿固定边权扩展，无法消解问题中的隐式实体指代，误差逐跳累积；探索式方法每跳都需LLM生成，推理成本高。作者发现LLM在生成前即可借助一小组“寻址头”（addressing heads）完成跨多跳的隐式实体消解，据此提出HyperAddress：在带描述标签的超图上运行Personal PageRank，用寻址头决定重启分布与转移权重，查询时无需任何生成即可引导多跳检索。在三个多跳数据集上平均Recall@5提升3.5点、All@5提升7.4点，跳数越多增益越大，回答速度提升一倍以上，索引构建成本减半。
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers multi-hop questions by organizing a corpus into a graph and retrieving along its structure. Existing retrieval methods face two limitations. Diffusion- and similarity-based methods expand retrieval along fixed edge weights or by similarity to the question, without resolving its implicit entity references, allowing relevance errors to accumulate across hops. In contrast, exploration-based methods let an LLM reason about the next hop, but require a separate generation at each hop, leading to high inference costs. We observe that an LLM can resolve implicit entity references from retrieved passages and a multi-hop question before generating any tokens. Further analysis identifies a small set of attention heads, termed addressing heads, that capture this capability across multiple hops in a single forward pass. Building on this finding, we propose HyperAddress, which runs Personalized PageRank on a description-labelled hypergraph, using addressing heads to determine the restart distribution and transition weights, thereby guiding multi-hop retrieval without any generation at query time. On MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA, HyperAddress outperforms the strongest baseline by 3.5 points of Recall@5 and 7.4 points of All@5 on average, with gains that grow with the number of hops. It answers more than twice as fast and builds its index at half the cost.

papers.title_en: From Voiceprints to User Entities: Online Speaker-Memory Construction for Multi-User Spoken Agents
papers.authors: Yucong Zhang, Cancan Li, Bo Xiao, Ke Zeng, Ming Li
papers.evidence: 面向语音智能体的按身份分区记忆写入与检索
papers.tldr: 多用户语音助手需先识别说话人再访问个性化记忆，但现有记忆基准常假设历史归属正确。论文将声纹视为身份观测而非身份本身，提出在线说话人记忆构建，并设计免训练层EvoSpeakerMem做因果路由、声学状态选择性更新与按身份隔离的读写。在SMIIP-TV上真伪探针拒绝率由29.8%升至55.6%，LoCoMo-ID干净/偏移条件下身份门控QA分别提升3.86和11.62个百分点且无误授权。并揭示碎片化与跨用户污染间的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized spoken agents must identify speakers before accessing user-specific memory, yet memory benchmarks typically assume correctly attributed histories. We argue that voiceprints are observations of identity, not identities themselves, and formulate online speaker-memory construction to maintain persistent user entities as acoustic evidence evolves. We introduce EvoSpeakerMem, a training-free layer for causal speaker routing, selective acoustic-state updates, and identity-partitioned memory writes and retrieval through a replaceable text-memory backend. We also construct LoCoMo-ID, a spoken-memory benchmark with hidden speaker identities, speaker-sensitive queries, simulated recording-condition shifts, and four-speaker identity-confusion tests. On longitudinal SMIIP-TV, genuine-probe rejection under a frozen near-enrollment threshold rises from 29.8% to 55.6% over approximately one year. On LoCoMo-ID speaker-sensitive queries, gated updating improves identity-gated QA over fixed representations by 3.86 and 11.62 percentage points under clean and shifted conditions, respectively, with no wrong-user authorizations. The advantage persists in the four-speaker test. Yet reducing fragmentation and improving QA can coexist with incorrect cross-user links, revealing a fragmentation--contamination trade-off that QA alone cannot capture.

papers.title_en: Decompose, Estimate, Select: Coverage-Aware Context Construction for Long-Form RAG
papers.authors: He Tu, Aleena Bosco Kurumthottam, Torsten Suel
papers.evidence: 面向长文档 RAG 证据落地的覆盖感知检索流程
papers.tldr: 长文RAG处理多面向问题时，相关性检索常返回冗余证据，部分需求缺乏支撑。作者提出覆盖感知流水线：分解查询为子问题，以覆盖训练双编码器排序，用交叉编码器预测文档×子问题覆盖矩阵，再按贪心最大边际覆盖选文档。在TREC RAG 2024上，α-nDCG@10由0.625升至0.702，接近金块上界0.718且不损相关性。作者还发现oracle检索未提升答案覆盖，遂加入grounded self-feedback loop，两轮使V_strict提高0.086并大体保持忠实。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's output in retrieved evidence, but for complex questions spanning multiple aspects of an information need, relevance-based retrieval may return redundant evidence while leaving some aspects unsupported. We propose a coverage-aware retrieval pipeline that decomposes queries into subquestions, ranks candidates with a coverage-trained bi-encoder, predicts a document\,$\times$\,subquestion coverage matrix with a cross-encoder, and selects documents by greedy maximum-marginal coverage. On TREC RAG 2024, our approach improves $α$-nDCG@10, which rewards newly covered nuggets and discounts redundant evidence, from $0.625$ to $0.702$, approaching the $0.718$ gold-nugget upper bound without sacrificing relevance. We then find that ground-truth oracle retrieval, despite substantially higher retrieval coverage, delivers no more nugget coverage to the answer than our estimated selection. This suggests that answer completeness depends not only on what evidence is retrieved, but also on how effectively the generator uses it. To address this, we introduce a \emph{grounded self-feedback loop} in which the model identifies underused evidence from its first answer and generates again without gold supervision, raising $V_{\mathrm{strict}}$, the fraction of vital reference nuggets fully supported by the answer, by $0.086$ over two passes while largely preserving faithfulness.

papers.title_en: DiaLong: Benchmarking Reminiscence in Long-Context Dialogues
papers.authors: Owen Bianchi, Samer Aslan, Ryunosuke Saito
papers.evidence: 面向长上下文对话记忆保持与回忆的基准
papers.tldr: LLM在长对话中常遗忘长程事实，却缺少量化评测基准。DiaLong构建100段人工创作并由LLM扩展的超长对话，设计40条候选事实真假分类的记忆任务，直接检验主动保持与检索能力。对最新LLM及记忆增强方法的测试显示，现有模型的长上下文记忆仍不足。该基准为改进长对话一致性、相关性和类人交互提供统一评估工具。
papers.abstract_en: How well can transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) retain and recall memories in long contexts of dialogue? LLMs are known to forget long-range factual information in their context, yet the field lacks a comprehensive benchmark to quantitatively assess these shortcomings. We present DiaLong, a long-context dialogue dataset and accompanying memory task that standardizes evaluation in this space. It consists of 100 unique conversations created by humans and then augmented with LLMs, extending beyond lengths found in existing datasets. Our selected memory task is fact recall: classify 40 candidate facts about a dialogue as true or false. This task directly probes the model's ability to actively retain and retrieve information, serving as a critical measure of memory within extended conversational contexts. In testing both the latest LLMs and proposed memory enhancements on DiaLong, we demonstrate that more work needs to be done to enable LLMs with better memory performance. By enhancing memory capabilities, LLMs can improve in maintaining coherence, relevance, and human-like interaction over extended conversation. Improving these capabilities will help LLMs fulfill diverse user needs and expectations in various conversational scenarios.

papers.title_en: StrucChunk: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Legal Document RAG
papers.authors: Surya Deep Singh, Ashutosh Tripathi, Gaurav Deep Singh
papers.evidence: 面向法律文档RAG的结构感知分块与混合检索
papers.tldr: 法律文档层级结构强，常规分块会打散论证结构，通用嵌入难以兼顾精确引用匹配与语义检索。StrucChunk 将文档建模为条款有向无环图，保留条款边界、嵌入前解析交叉引用，并用 RRF 融合 BM25 与 BGE-M3。在五套语料、三大法系、两种语言上，其边界精度达100%，LegalBench-RAG 的 Char-Recall@8 由23.59%升至48.18%，超过已发表SOTA 83%。作者开源实现与5,256条评测查询，表明结构对齐是法律RAG的主要增益来源。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can ground LLM outputs in domain-specific knowledge, but legal documents are hard: standard chunking fragments hierarchical argument structure, and generic embeddings struggle with both precise citation matching and semantic understanding. We propose StrucChunk (Structure Aware Chunking) with hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for hierarchically structured legal documents. It treats documents as directed acyclic graphs of provisions, preserves clause boundaries, resolves cross-references before embedding, and combines BM25 with BGE-M3 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. We evaluate on five corpora, three legal traditions and two languages. StrucChunk reaches 100% boundary precision (vs. 7.7% for recursive splitting on CrPC), preserves 97.6% of documented cross-references (vs. 0%), and matches section coverage with 40.3% fewer chunks on GDPR. On LegalBench-RAG (6,858 query-passage pairs), it achieves Char-Recall@8 of 48.18% vs. 23.59% for the best baseline (+104%), surpassing the published state of the art by +83%. On 501 queries each for CrPC and CPC (Indian law), Recall@5 improves from 0.557 to 0.804 (+44.4%) and from 0.158 to 0.259 (+64.6%); chunking accounts for 88% and 73% of the gain. On 501 GDPR queries, Recall@5 is 0.868 with R@1 improving +59%. On NitiBench-CCL (3,730 Thai financial law queries), HR@5 is 0.856 vs. 0.594 for naive chunking (+44.1%), showing that section-boundary alignment is the dominant factor across languages, and cross-reference augmentation adds +2.3% on cross-reference queries. We release the implementation, 5,256 evaluation queries across five legal corpora, annotation methodology and chunking quality metrics. Code: github.com/SinghSuryaDeep/legal-rag-strucchunk-1

papers.title_en: Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Xinyu Liu, Daiying Tian, Chenwei Tang, Ruyang Han, Chengyang Zhang, Qingyu Zeng, Wei Ju, Liangli Zhen, Jiancheng Lv
papers.evidence: 面向长程任务的智能体认知记忆架构
papers.tldr: 长程机器人操作中的VLA模型受限于长期记忆建模：隐式时序表示易稀释历史，显式缓存则冗余且检索低效。CogMemory将多模态轨迹经选择性状态空间编码、多槽时序抽象与变分压缩为紧凑潜在记忆。动作生成时以动态交叉注意力检索和门控融合注入相关记忆，仅增3.45M参数即可适配多种VLA骨干。长程操作基准上取得跨骨干的一致提升，为VLA长期记忆提供轻量可复用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. Existing methods either rely on implicit temporal representations within policy networks, where historical information can be gradually diluted, or maintain explicit memory buffers that suffer from redundancy, noise accumulation, and inefficient retrieval. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information. Our approach encodes multimodal trajectories into compact latent memory representations through a selective state- space memory encoder, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression. During action generation, dynamic cross-attention retrieval with gated fusion adaptively incorporates relevant memories into policy prediction. With merely 3.45M additional parameters, CogMemory stays lightweight and seamlessly fits both early- and intermediate-fusion VLA backbones. Extensive experiments on long-horizon robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse VLA backbones.

papers.title_en: UniGFM-RAG: Unify Graph Foundation Models and Large Language Models for End-to-End Retrieval and Reasoning
papers.authors: Zicheng Zhao, Linhao Luo, Zongji Yu, Junnan Dong, Yanchao Tan, Shirui Pan, Chen Gong
papers.evidence: 结合图基础模型的统一端到端图检索增强生成
papers.tldr: 现有 GraphRAG 多采用“先检索、再生成”的解耦流水线，导致检索目标与推理目标不一致，且训练 GFM 检索器依赖昂贵人工标注。本文提出 UniGFM-RAG，将图基础模型（GFM）检索器与 LLM 生成器紧密耦合：检索器在图上打分并取回文档节点，再经可微图桥按检索分数投影为软加权图前缀，与原文拼成图增强提示，使答案损失可反传并联合优化检索与推理。方法还引入语义引导蒸馏，用查询-文档语义相似度伪标签提供辅助监督。在多跳问答与域外 GraphRAG 基准上，它稳定优于强基线且泛化良好。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across tasks, but they still struggle with complex reasoning that requires integrating scattered knowledge. Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) addresses this challenge by organizing fragment knowledge as graphs, while recent Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) further improve GraphRAG with graph-native retrieval and reasoning capabilities. However, existing GraphRAG methods usually adopt decoupled retrieve-then-generate pipelines, which create objective misalignment between retrieval and reasoning, and training GFM retrievers typically depends on expensive human annotations. To address these limitations, we propose \ourmethod, a unified end-to-end GraphRAG framework that tightly couples a GFM retriever with an LLM generator. Given a query, the GFM retriever first reasons over the graph to score and retrieve relevant document nodes. These node embeddings are then passed through a fully differentiable graph bridge, which projects them into soft-weighted graph prefixes according to retrieval scores and combines them with raw document texts to form graph-augmented prompts. In this way, structural information is injected directly into LLM generation, while the final answer loss can be back-propagated through the bridge to jointly optimize retrieval and reasoning. To stabilize training and reduce reliance on costly annotations, we further introduce a semantic-guided distillation module that provides auxiliary supervision using pseudo-labels derived from query-document semantic similarities. Extensive experiments on three multi-hop QA datasets and three out-of-domain GraphRAG benchmarks show that \ourmethod consistently outperforms strong baseline methods and generalizes well, which demonstrates the effectiveness of end-to-end GraphRAG with tightly integrated GFM retrieval and LLM reasoning.

papers.title_en: Remember Less, Adapt Longer: Bounded-State In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Summary Memory
papers.authors: Jiawen Wang, Cheng Xue, Peng Zhang, Jochen Renz
papers.evidence: 有界循环摘要记忆平衡智能体存储成本与历史访问
papers.tldr: 面向持续运行智能体的上下文强化学习需要在有限成本下保留经验，但现有记忆方案要么随任务增长而成本上升，要么因固定窗口或循环压缩而丢失信息。作者提出循环摘要记忆RSM：策略精确关注近期交互的短工作缓冲区，并以固定容量摘要承载更早经验，缓冲区满时重写摘要后清空。在长时部分可观测任务上，冻结策略可维持训练时域八倍的适应性能，仅用约1%全历史内存，且优于所有基线。
papers.abstract_en: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables agents to adapt to new tasks without parameter updates, relying on memory to retain what they learn from experience. For agents operating continually, existing approaches using memory trade off bounded cost against access to past experience. Approaches using growing memories, such as full-history attention and accumulating summaries, incur storage and per-decision costs that increase with task length. Fixed-size memories bound storage but restrict access: sliding windows discard older steps, while recurrent networks compress even recent interactions into a hidden state. We introduce Recurrent Summary Memory (RSM), a Transformer policy that attends exactly to a short working buffer of recent interactions and carries a fixed-capacity summary of earlier experience. When the buffer fills, RSM rewrites the summary from its previous contents and the buffer, then clears the buffer, so deployment memory and per-decision cost stay $O(1)$ in task length. On long-running partially observable tasks, frozen RSM policies sustain their adapted performance for eight times the training horizon with about 1% of full-history memory, ending ahead of every evaluated baseline while growing memories deteriorate. When the task configuration changes mid-run, RSM re-adapts better than growing and recurrent memories. Clearing the summary or blocking the policy's access to it removes its benefit, while swapping in another task's summary steers behaviour towards that task. Together, these results show that our fixed-capacity summary can sustain in-context adaptation far beyond the training horizon.

papers.title_en: LVMem: Image-Augmented Memory for Long-Horizon Question Answering
papers.authors: Victoria Khoruzhaya, Maksim Kalmykov, Tuong Do Minh, Tatiana Zemskova, Yixin Zhu, Dmitry Yudin
papers.evidence: 面向长程具身智能体的图像增强持久场景记忆
papers.tldr: 面向具身智能体长时程问答，现有基于视图的记忆多只存文本描述或视觉嵌入，难以在长观测历史中可靠定位对象与事件。LVMem在ReMEmbR式记忆中加入图像路径，并用光流帧选择PSFR和以对象为中心的描述替代均匀采样与普通字幕，使每条记忆可回溯原始图像。基于VLM的智能体配备自适应检索工具，可按需调取最相关描述对应的图像进行视觉核验。在OC-NaVQA上，LVMem在二值与位置指标上优于ReMEmbR，二值准确率匹配或超过4D场景图DAAAM基线，且无需显式构图。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable language-guided perception is essential for embodied agents, where questions about objects, events, and their locations must be answered from long observation histories. Unlike conventional visual question answering, realistic robotic settings require reasoning over extended temporal horizons and persistent scene memory. We build upon the view-based memory paradigm and propose an efficient framework for long-horizon spatio-temporal question answering. While existing view-based systems typically store either text captions or visual embeddings, we extend the ReMEmbR-style memory with image paths that link each stored description to its original visual content. To make the stored annotations more informative, we replace uniform sampling during memory construction with an optical-flow-based frame selection strategy (PSFR) and store an object-centric descriptive scene representation instead of plain captions. We further equip a VLM-based agent with an adaptive retrieval tool that returns the image associated with the most relevant caption, allowing the agent to decide when visual inspection is needed. On the OC-NaVQA benchmark, LVMem outperforms ReMEmbR on binary and positional metrics with both backbones and matches or exceeds a 4D scene graph DAAAM baseline on binary accuracy, while operating on a lightweight view-based memory that requires no explicit graph construction.

papers.title_en: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Yufeng Li, Zaijing Li, Fuchen Zhang, Zongzong Wu, Ming Zhao, Fengxiao Tang
papers.evidence: 语义拓扑RAG框架，用于多跳问答中的上下文一致性保持
papers.tldr: 针对RAG结合知识图谱做多跳问答时的语义丢失与图-文本模态错配，ThreadRAG提出语义拓扑框架，保留上下文并实现模态原生推理。STM把检索文档组织为上下文完整的语义节点，并以叙事、语义、词汇边构建语义拓扑图；EDP用能量扩散定位相关子图，再确定性线性化为连贯文本证据路径。三个多跳QA基准上稳定领先，HotpotQA的EM较文本中心方法提升14.4%，2WikiMultihop较最佳基线提升5.8%，token成本仅为最强基线的23.3%。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.

papers.title_en: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
papers.authors: Maria Ana Cardei, Aniket Singh, Amir Moghadam, Srividhya Baikadi, Rashmi Shetty
papers.evidence: 面向RAG检索流水线的智能体树搜索优化
papers.tldr: RAG检索管道优化需在有限评估预算下联合选择结构组件与数值超参。IRAH结合LATS-IR与离线元学习初始化，以UCT引导分层搜索，先探索宏结构再精调数值参数，并用自然语言反思指导后续变异。在三个分布内基准中两个优于TPE，最高提升6.4%，分布外仍有竞争力；四基准平均nDCG@10为0.4816且优于冷启动。这表明IRAH是受限预算下具竞争力的检索管道优化方法。
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing Information Retrieval (IR) pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) requires jointly selecting structural components and numerical hyperparameters under limited evaluation budgets. We introduce the Information Retrieval Agentic Harness (IRAH), which combines Language Agent Tree Search for IR (LATS-IR) with offline meta-learned initialization. LATS-IR performs UCT-guided hierarchical search, first exploring macro-structural pipeline choices and then refining numerical parameters, with natural-language reflections to guide subsequent mutations and provide inspectable search traces. We evaluate IRAH on three in-distribution benchmarks and one out of-distribution benchmark to assess generalization under distribution shift. Under the same meta-learned initialization, LATS-IR outperforms TPE on two of three in-distribution benchmarks, with gains of up to 6.4%, and remains competitive on the out-of-distribution benchmark. Across all four benchmarks, warm-started IRAH achieves the highest average held-out nDCG@10 (0.4816) and improves over its cold-start counterpart. These results establish IRAH as a competitive approach to retrieval pipeline optimization under constrained evaluation budgets.

papers.title_en: Holding a Steady Course: Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons for Continual Agent Learning
papers.authors: Wenzhe Fan, Benjamin Steenhoek, Gaurav Mittal, Yu Hu
papers.evidence: 借助验证证据将记忆与技能整合为可靠知识
papers.tldr: 自主智能体在连续相关任务中常难以保留并提升知识，且自动积累的技能与记忆可能传播错误、污染有用知识。为此，作者提出智能体无关框架KEEL，利用验证器证据把成功行为转化为可复用技能、把失败转化为纠正性经验，并依据新证据支持、反驳、替换或淘汰技能主张。在SkillFlow基准上，KEEL相较无知识基线提升任务成功率4.2至21.7个百分点，明显高于默认方法的2.4至9.6个百分点。消融表明技能与经验互补，说明持续学习的关键不只是积累经验，而是持续验证并演化知识。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time. Existing approaches convert interaction trajectories into memories or reusable skills, but experience is not automatically reliable knowledge. Automatically collected skills and memories can propagate errors, mislead, and corrupt useful knowledge. To address this gap, we introduce Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons (KEEL), an agent-agnostic framework that uses verifier evidence to transform successful behavior into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons. As new evidence accumulates, individual skill claims can be supported, contradicted, replaced, or retired. On SkillFlow benchmark, KEEL improves task success by 4.2 to 21.7 percentage points over the no-knowledge baseline, compared with gains of 2.4 to 9.6 points from SkillFlow's default method. Ablations show that skills and lessons are complementary. These results show that reliable continual agent learning depends not simply on accumulating experience, but on continually validating and evolving the knowledge derived from it. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/KEEL-TTCL26.

papers.title_en: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
papers.authors: Zhen Bi, Zhizhi Peng, Yan Wang, Xueshu Chen, Haofei Zhang, Yaobo Zhang, Zeyu Yang, Qing Shen, Jungang Lou
papers.evidence: 面向长程智能体的外部经验记忆卡与检索
papers.tldr: 长程智能体需要持续复用可迁移的过程知识，但现有系统多在模型适配或外部记忆间二选一，难以兼顾持久学习与快速复用。HaMo 提出 Harness-Model 协同框架，将轨迹蒸馏为策略级经验卡供即时检索，并用经验条件持续学习目标训练模型理解、落地和执行检索策略。它还用检索覆盖选择机制挑选紧凑互补轨迹更新参数。实验表明其在域内与跨域迁移下优于仅 harness 或仅模型适配，兼顾保持与适应。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain shifts, improving both retention and adaptation. These results highlight the importance of jointly preserving procedural experience and internalizing the competence to transfer and execute it across tasks.

papers.title_en: ACARE: Agent-Context-Aware Reranker for Iterative Search
papers.authors: Sahel Sharifymoghaddam, Yauhen Babakhin, Reza Esfandiarpoor, Oliver Holworthy, Jimmy Lin, Bo Liu
papers.evidence: 智能体感知重排序提升迭代搜索中的证据质量
papers.tldr: 在智能体检索中，文档可能匹配子查询却无助于回答原问题，而传统重排器只看子查询、忽略任务与推理上下文。本文提出 ACARe，一个 4B 小型大模型，利用智能体上下文对文档重排。多基准多智能体实验显示，它提升检索质量并减少搜索次数，还改善答案生成。
papers.abstract_en: In agentic search, a document can match an agent-generated sub-query without helping answer the user's original question. Conventional rerankers score documents against the sub-query alone, overlooking the broader task and the agent's reasoning. We introduce the Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe), a compact 4B LLM trained to rerank documents using this context when available. Across multiple benchmarks and agent families, ACARe improves retrieval quality over its base reranker while reducing search effort. These benefits extend to answer generation: ACARe improves accuracy and reduces searches over no reranking, while matching or exceeding the base reranker's mean accuracy with more precise evidence. It also helps smaller agents narrow the retrieval-quality gap to larger agents, showing how better retrieval tools can make smaller agents more effective. The model, training data, and code will be released soon.

papers.title_en: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
papers.authors: Chao Wan, Paul Jünger, Beixi Du, Bodong Liu, Navaneetha Krishnan, Kilian Q. Weinberger
papers.evidence: 用决策模型替代嵌入检索器的检索增强策略
papers.tldr: 现有检索多依赖词面匹配或固定嵌入相似度，检索器找不到的内容，生成器再强也难以恢复。DecisionRAG 将预训练语言模型用作决策模型，在单次前向中联合评估候选分支且不生成 token，使共享上下文下的相关性判断可比，并沿语料结构从主题逐层导航到段落。无需任务训练或一阶段检索器，它在 MultiDoc2Dial 和 Natural Questions 上分别比 8B 重排器的稠密检索高 13.8 R@1 和 17.4 Hit@1，四个基准上单查询检索仅 0.7-1.8 秒。
papers.abstract_en: While language models have become dramatically more capable, retrieval still largely relies on lexical matching or similarity in fixed embedding spaces. This creates a capability asymmetry: what the retriever fails to find, even the strongest generator cannot recover. We propose DecisionRAG, which brings the capabilities of pretrained language models to retrieval using decision models that jointly evaluate candidate branches in a single forward pass, without generating any tokens, and show that judging candidates in a shared context makes their relevance estimates comparable. Like a person browsing a library, DecisionRAG navigates the corpus's inherent structure from broad topics down to individual passages, deciding at each level which branches are worth exploring. Without task-specific training or a first-stage retriever, DecisionRAG outperforms dense retrieval with an 8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 points on MultiDoc2Dial and 17.4 Hit@1 points on Natural Questions. Across four benchmarks, including a corpus of 2.68 million Wikipedia paragraphs, retrieval takes just 0.7-1.8 seconds per query.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction
papers.authors: Zhe Xu, Tianhao Liao, Zhenqing Ling, Ying Shen, Yaliang Li, Daoyuan Chen
papers.evidence: 免训练语义树为问答选取支撑证据
papers.tldr: 长上下文模型虽可直接吞下整篇文档，但容量大并不等于能选对支撑答案的信息。作者提出免训练的 TreeFuse 框架，用语义抽象指导证据选择、同时保留原文用于作答。在三个 LongBench 任务上，四个前沿答题模型的平均 QA-F1 比全上下文提示提升 1.72 分，且答案上下文长度减少 58.55%。这为长上下文时代的“检索”提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural--semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; their union with ancestor context preserves structural relations and complete local text. Across four frontier answer models, \ours improves average QA-F1 by 1.72 points over full-context prompting on three LongBench tasks, surpassing the evaluated baselines on the four-model average while reducing answer-context length by 58.55\%. Our code is available at the $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/treefuse-ECFE}{repository}$.

papers.title_en: When Relevant Code Is Wrong: Runtime-Aware Context for AI Coding Agents
papers.authors: Wesley K. G. Assunção, Ramesh Periyathambi
papers.evidence: 面向AI编程智能体的运行时感知检索上下文
papers.tldr: AI编程代理常依赖检索到的代码与开发历史，但高相关工件可能因特性开关、架构迁移和部署配置而失效。CASE框架将仓库工件与运行时配置、架构演化关联，把证据分为有效、无效或未知，并生成可操作上下文包。初步评估中，传统检索将16处不兼容工件误判为可操作，CASE将其排除并保留适用工件；近期性过滤使有效召回降至0.43，移除特性开关证据后降至0.13。该工作揭示相关性检索的局限，提出“运行有效性”这一新检索原则。
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents increasingly rely on retrieved code and development history to guide software changes. However, highly relevant artifacts may describe implementations that are inactive or incompatible with the target deployment. Neither semantic similarity nor recency establishes whether retrieved information remains applicable under feature flags, architectural migrations, and deployment-specific configurations. We challenge relevance-oriented retrieval by introducing operational context validity, a task-, deployment-, and time-dependent criterion for determining whether software evidence can legitimately guide implementation decisions. We instantiate this new retrieval principle in CASE, an agent-agnostic framework that connects repository artifacts with runtime configurations and architectural evolution, classifies evidence as valid, invalid, or unknown, and generates context packages distinguishing actionable guidance from historical rationale and unresolved constraints. We investigate its feasibility through a reproducible preliminary evaluation involving six development tasks, 15 artifacts, and three deployments. Conventional retrieval exposes 16 incompatible artifact occurrences as actionable, whereas CASE excludes them while retaining all applicable artifacts under the prototype's reference rules. Recency filtering reduces valid recall to 0.43, while removing feature-flag evidence from CASE reduces it to 0.13. Although these results demonstrate feasibility rather than improvements in coding-agent correctness, they reveal limitations of relevance-based retrieval and motivate a new research direction: enabling coding agents to reason not only about which information is relevant, but also whether it remains operationally valid.

papers.evidence: 模型层与智能体框架层的上下文检索与压缩
papers.tldr: 世界模型在观察者重访区域时常无法一致重建，本文将其视为上下文检索问题。作者构建按每回合生成新世界的基准，分离检索与邻近帧猜测，并设计面向世界模型的智能体框架做上下文压缩。实验显示压缩可在不重训下把房间检索扩展到上下文窗口4倍，但滑动窗口注意力在梦境生成时检索大幅下降。该工作补齐智能体框架层研究，表明扩展模型可达范围优于切换滑动窗口注意力。
papers.abstract_en: World models let observers explore and interact with generated worlds. Recent work shows that when observers revisit a region, current models often fail to regenerate it consistently. We view this as a context retrieval problem. LLM agents manage context retrieval at two layers of their stack. At the model layer, the KV cache design determines how much context fits in memory. At the agent harness layer, harnesses such as Claude Code pick the context sent to the LLM. Prior work on world models has mostly focused only on the model layer. In this paper, we make three contributions. First, we build a benchmark to measure world model context retrieval. It generates new worlds for every episode, preventing a model from recalling rooms using training data. It also separates context retrieval from guesses based on nearby frames. Second, we build an agent harness that performs context compaction for world models, which to our knowledge no prior work has studied. Third, we use our benchmark to study four world model designs. Context compaction lets our world models retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining. However, world models with sliding-window attention lose most of their context retrieval when dreaming. Therefore, a dreaming world agent benefits more from extending the reach of its world model using context compaction than switching to sliding window attention at the model layer.

papers.title_en: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Lingkai Kong, Yuzhe Gu, Haiteng Zhao, Zijian Wu, Youqing Fang, Zhouqi Hua, Yanan Sun, Kai Chen, Wenwei Zhang
papers.evidence: 大模型自主检索与应用知识
papers.tldr: 针对陌生领域问题求解需要动态获取并运用知识，现有参数知识与RAG难以充分支持。作者构建教科书数学证明任务和BookNavigator交互界面，用细粒度奖励强化学习激励模型自主检索、研读并应用长文本材料。实验将Intern-S2-Preview-35B证明准确率从51.5%提升至79.5%，优于无教材与固定检索基线，并在长上下文基准上取得提升。结果表明强化学习可培养领域无关的自学策略，增强复杂长上下文问题求解能力。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.
